quotes.text: There was a period — I think it was during the Thriller sessions — where Quincy would just let the tape roll even when nobody thought we were recording. Some of my best scratch vocals from that time ended up on the actual record and I didn't even know it until I heard the playback. That used to terrify me and now I think it's probably the only reason those songs sound the way they do.
